metric: MSE of cell-averaged RGB over the active image
measured_against: scaled source before Spectrum palette quantization

colour_comparison.chroma_metric: Squared R-G and B-G differences; not a perceptual grade
colour_comparison.selector: source-RGB line drawing with matched native solid fills
colour_comparison.source_guard_scope: Stylistic line drawing. Fill labels are source-matched, but no photographic RGB error bound is claimed. Black contours and uniform white paper override unsupported optional third-colour fills.
colour_comparison.available_fill_colours: Normal and BRIGHT Spectrum colours. Fixed white paper RGB205 must remain exact; cells with paper cannot select a BRIGHT colour.
